system.description: When you hit an enemy with an attack, you may impose a condition on the enemy. This ability starts at Rank 3 when it imposes 1 value of a given condition (if the condition has values). At Rank 4 it imposes 2 values of a condition; at Rank 5 it imposes 3 values. This ability may be taken multiple times; each time you take it, you must choose the condition it imposes.
